name: Runemaster Hurricane cannot be feared (#7716)
contract: #7716: a Spirit Mage (class 32, the Runemaster) was feared while Hurricane (645435) was active, and the
ability is a 2 s self-lock whose tooltip only promises increased dodge at the price of not using spells or
abilities. Its client row grants no control immunity: effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_ALLOW_ONLY_ABILITY (263) on the
caster, which is exactly that lock. The immunity is scripted, in this fork's own idiom - AscensionCultistAuras'
Immunity() helper is Unit::ApplySpellImmune(source, IMMUNITY_MECHANIC, mechanic, apply) - and nothing granted
it for this ability. aura_ascension_runemaster_hurricane now applies IMMUNITY_MECHANIC MECHANIC_FEAR for the
ability's own id while its aura is up and removes it in End before End's early-outs, so the immunity lasts
exactly as long as the ability and covers both the Runemaster Hurricane and its Wildcard sibling. The scenario
drives the real cast path with a hostile caster - Fear (5782) from a unit of hostile faction, the same shape the
stun-immunity scenario uses: while the ability is running the fear does not land, and the same fear from the
same caster lands as soon as the ability has ended, which is also the control that the fear can land at all.
The ability itself must still work: its aura applies, its strike lands and it ends on its own.
